bull.b: A 20-year, 191 MW contracted lease creates durable, high-margin contracted cash flows once deployed. The large initial-term revenue and 80%–90% NOI guidance materially diversifies Riot toward predictable data-center income, reducing sole reliance on block-reward mining volatility over the multi-year lease term.

Having $1.2B of combined cash and bitcoin plus a $573M interim facility provides near-term funding optionality to procure long-lead equipment and advance builds. This liquidity buffer materially reduces immediate refinancing pressure, enabling phased project execution and lowering short-term dilution risk while operations scale.

Rapidly expanding engineering revenue, meaningful margin improvement, and a sizable backlog indicate a durable operational competency. Increased manufacturing capacity shortens supply lead times, supports on‑schedule deployments, and creates a higher-margin, recurring services stream that complements capital-intensive leasing and mining activities.

bear.b: Sustained negative operating and free cash flow means Riot consumes cash to fund operations and growth, increasing reliance on external financing or asset sales. Over months, persistent cash burn elevates liquidity and execution risk, particularly if project timelines slip or capital markets tighten, constraining self-funded expansion.

bear.t: Very high capital intensity and financing needs
bear.b: Large upfront CapEx and heavy expected project leverage create structural execution and financing risk. The business model depends on securing sizable, timely project financing and equity; any shortfall or higher-than-expected financing costs would raise funding needs or dilution, compressing returns on multi-year leases and slowing rollout.

bear.t: Exposure to Bitcoin price and mining volatility
bear.b: Riot's core mining revenue and treasury value remain tied to volatile Bitcoin prices. Regular selling of mined BTC to fund builds reduces treasury upside and links liquidity to market timing. Combined with variable hash utilization and network difficulty, this creates durable earnings and funding volatility across quarters.
